summary: Backend tests for the per-user report-quota system. 12/12 pytest cases passed. Verified plans shape (trial_10, annual, upcoming agency_starter), fresh-user auth/me quota fields, 402 on quota=0, quota consumption on distinct (month,year), regeneration bypass (same month is free), delete frees the slot, quota exhaustion on new month, admin unlimited bypass, redeem annual code $inc +12 and trial_10 $inc +1, Cashfree order creation rejects 'agency_starter' with 400 Unknown plan, /admin/users includes reports_quota, and regression on /settings/seller GET + admin PUT.

minor.issue: trial_end still computed with timedelta(days=15) (line 72) even though trial plan is now 7 days. Doesn't affect quota logic but is inconsistent with the new plan definition (PLANS['trial_10'].days=7). Consider aligning with plan days or gating trial_end via plan lookup.

New users are seeded with trial_start=now() but NO reports_quota field. reports_quota is coerced to 0 via int(user.get('reports_quota') or 0) at read-time, which works today but leaves the doc missing the field until first $inc. Prefer explicit reports_quota:0 on insert for auditability.

action_items: Optional: align trial_end calculation in user_status() with PLANS['trial_10'].days (currently hardcoded to 15 days).
Optional: set reports_quota:0 explicitly at user creation for schema consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1065 lines — nearing the >700-line threshold for splitting into modules (auth, reports, plans/codes, payments, admin).
_distinct_months_used() correctly uses aggregation but is called twice per create (via _has_month_report + _distinct_months_used); minor N+1 but acceptable for current scale.
Redeem/cashfree/_mark_user_paid all use $inc reports_quota — good for carry-forward semantics. But if a user's doc lacks reports_quota, $inc will create it; fine with MongoDB semantics.
Admin /admin/users returns full user docs — no PII filtering (emails, picture URLs exposed). Acceptable for admin-only endpoint but worth noting.
No index on reports.(user_id, target_month, target_year) — _has_month_report and _distinct_months_used aggregation would benefit from a compound index. Existing index is (user_id, created_at).
test_credentials: Injected test sessions directly via mongosh-style pymongo inserts using the recipe in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. All test users and their reports/sessions/activation_codes are cleaned up after each test via fixtures.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: each test creates a scoped test-user (prefix test-quota-<uuid>) with a bearer session token and, where needed, activation codes. All cleaned up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quota system is fully wired: PLANS/UPCOMING_PLANS at server.py:508-519, with_quota() at 118-133, create_report guard at 291-304, redeem $inc at 569, cashfree fulfill $inc at 753, stripe _mark_user_paid $inc at 967. All backend paths tested. If UI changes later, test the pricing page (Agency Starter should show 'Coming soon', trial+annual purchasable), the report create button (should surface 402 message), and the account panel (should display reports_remaining/quota).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the new quota feature.
